title_en: Changzhi Dayang Electric Appliance Co., Ltd. v. BSH Home Appliances (China) Co., Ltd. — dispute over sales contract
ruling_gist_en: The judgment on nullification of rights rendered by a people's court with respect to a negotiable instrument constitutes a reconfirmation of rights. The negotiable instrument loses its validity from the date of announcement of the judgment on nullification of rights, and the holder loses the rights under the instrument, thereby separating the original rights holder from the instrument. The applicant in the public summons procedure is entitled to request the drawee of the instrument to make payment based on the judgment on nullification of rights. However, the loss of the holder's rights under the instrument does not imply the loss of underlying civil rights. The holder still has the right to assert civil rights based on the underlying contract and to exercise the right of set-off in the performance of debts under the underlying contract, which does not harm the lawful rights and interests of the counterparty to the underlying contract.

full_text_en:
Changzhi Dayang Electric Appliances Co., Ltd. v. BSH Home Appliances (China) Co., Ltd. — Dispute over a Sales Contract

Ruling Summary

The annulment judgment issued by a people's court with respect to a negotiable instrument constitutes a reaffirmation of rights. From the date of announcement of such judgment, the negotiable instrument loses its validity, and the holder loses the rights under the instrument, thereby separating the original rights holder from the instrument. The applicant for public summons for exhortation is then entitled to request payment from the drawee of the instrument on the basis of the annulment judgment. However, the loss of rights under the instrument does not mean the loss of underlying civil rights. The holder is still entitled to assert civil rights based on the underlying contract and may exercise the right of set-off in performance of the underlying contract, without prejudicing the lawful rights and interests of the counterparty to the underlying contract.

Plaintiff: Changzhi Dayang Electric Appliances Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Chengdong Road, Changzhi City, Shanxi Province.
Legal representative: Zang Yongda, Chairperson of the Board of the Company.
Defendant: BSH Home Appliances (China) Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Zhongshan Road, Gulou District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province.
Legal representative: Roland Gerke, President of the Company.

The plaintiff, Changzhi Dayang Electric Appliances Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dayang Company), filed an action with the Gulou District People's Court of Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, against the defendant, BSH Home Appliances (China) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as BSH Company), concerning a dispute over a sales contract.

The plaintiff Dayang Company alleged: Dayang Company and the defendant BSH Company had a long-term cooperative relationship. On March 6, 2010, Dayang Company and BSH Company respectively entered into a 2010 Siemens refrigerator/washing machine sales contract, a 2010 Siemens water heater/kitchen appliance sales contract, and a 2010 Bosch refrigerator/washing machine/wine cooler sales contract. Dayang Company was to pay prepayments to BSH Company, and BSH Company would supply home appliances according to Dayang Company's orders. In July 2010, Dayang Company paid Guo Pengfei RMB 290,000 and obtained a bank acceptance draft with the drawer being Shanxi Lu'an Environmental Energy Development Co., Ltd., the date of issue being June 22, 2010, the draft number being GA0101930426, the face amount being RMB 300,000, and the maturity date being December 22, 2010. Dayang Company delivered this bank acceptance draft to BSH Company as payment for goods. Upon receipt, BSH Company endorsed it to BSH Huayang Home Appliances Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as BSH Huayang Company). On July 23, 2010, BSH Huayang Company applied for discount with the Chuzhou Branch of Bank of China Limited (hereinafter referred to as Chuzhou BOC). After verification and confirmation, Chuzhou BOC paid the discounted amount to BSH Huayang Company. In December 2010, Chuzhou BOC learned that an annulment judgment had been rendered by the Xinghualing District People's Court of Taiyuan City on October 20, 2010, with respect to this bank acceptance draft. Subsequently, Chuzhou BOC returned the bank acceptance draft to BSH Huayang Company, which in turn returned it to BSH Company. On December 23, 2010, BSH Company returned the bank acceptance draft to Dayang Company and issued a notice of draft return, stating that because the draft had been annulled, the subsequent holder under the draft had claimed back the funds and returned the instrument, and therefore BSH Company decided to deduct RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment. At the time Dayang Company endorsed and delivered the bank acceptance draft to BSH Company, the draft was not subject to any stop-payment order and had not been annulled; BSH Company accepted it, and the payment of the prepayment was free of any defect. Because the subsequent holder of BSH Company was negligent in exercising its rights under the instrument, BSH Company returned the annulled bank acceptance draft to Dayang Company and deducted the amount from Dayang Company's prepayment, thereby infringing Dayang Company's lawful rights and interests. Dayang Company petitioned the court to order BSH Company to continue performance of the 2010 Siemens refrigerator/washing machine sales contract, the 2010 Siemens water heater/kitchen appliance sales contract, and the 2010 Bosch refrigerator/washing machine/wine cooler sales contract entered into between the parties, and to refrain from deducting the corresponding payment from Dayang Company on the ground that the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000 had been annulled.

The defendant BSH Company argued: The home appliance sales contracts between the plaintiff Dayang Company and BSH Company were in fact still being performed. The claim of Dayang Company for continued performance of the sales contracts did not exist. Dayang Company had paid a prepayment of RMB 300,000 to BSH Company in the form of the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426. Subsequently, an annulment judgment was rendered by the court with respect to this draft, and it was declared invalid. BSH Company returned the bank acceptance draft to Dayang Company, which now holds the instrument. Therefore, Dayang Company had not actually paid the RMB 300,000 under the instrument to BSH Company. BSH Company's deduction of RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment account was lawful and reasonable and did not infringe Dayang Company's lawful rights and interests. BSH Company petitioned the court to dismiss Dayang Company's claims.

The court of first instance, the Gulou District People's Court of Nanjing City, found the following facts:

The plaintiff Dayang Company and the defendant BSH Company had a long-term business cooperative relationship. On March 6, 2010, Dayang Company and BSH Company respectively entered into a 2010 Siemens refrigerator/washing machine sales contract, a 2010 Siemens water heater/kitchen appliance sales contract, and a 2010 Bosch refrigerator/washing machine/wine cooler sales contract. Dayang Company was to make prepayments to BSH Company, and BSH Company would supply home appliances according to Dayang Company's orders.

In July 2010, the plaintiff Dayang Company paid Guo Pengfei RMB 290,000 and obtained a bank acceptance draft with the drawer being Shanxi Lu'an Environmental Energy Development Co., Ltd., the date of issue being June 22, 2010, the draft number being GA0101930426, the face amount being RMB 300,000, and the maturity date being December 22, 2010. The immediate prior holder (endorser) of the bank acceptance draft as recorded was Changzhi Hongteng Trading Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hongteng Company). On July 5, 2010, Dayang Company endorsed the bank acceptance draft it held to BSH Company for the purpose of paying a prepayment. After receiving the bank acceptance draft, BSH Company endorsed it to BSH Huayang Company. On July 23, 2010, BSH Huayang Company and Chuzhou BOC entered into a draft discount agreement, the main contents of which were: the discount rate was 4%; regardless of the reason for the draft being returned or Chuzhou BOC being unable to receive the draft proceeds on time, Chuzhou BOC should have recourse against BSH Huayang Company, and BSH Huayang Company agreed that Chuzhou BOC might deduct the unpaid draft amount and interest and related expenses during the period of delayed receipt from the account of BSH Huayang Company opened at Chuzhou BOC. After verifying and confirming the authenticity, legality, and validity of the bank acceptance draft, Chuzhou BOC paid the discounted amount of RMB 294,833.33 to BSH Huayang Company on the same day.

After Chuzhou BOC held the bank acceptance draft and paid the discounted amount to BSH Huayang Company, Hongteng Company applied to the Xinghualing District People's Court of Taiyuan City (hereinafter referred to as Xinghualing Court) for public summons for exhortation on the ground that the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 had been lost. The court accepted the application and published a notice in the *People's Court Daily* on August 6, 2010. On October 9, 2010, the Xinghualing Court rendered a civil judgment [(2010) Xing Min Cui Zi No. 34], declaring the aforesaid instrument invalid, and published a notice in the *People's Court Daily* on October 20, 2010.

After learning of the above in November 2010, Chuzhou BOC returned the bank acceptance draft to BSH Huayang Company, which later returned it to the defendant BSH Company. On December 7, 2010, Chuzhou BOC issued an "Explanation Regarding the Handling of the Discounted Bank Acceptance Draft as a Return Due to Stop-Payment" to BSH Huayang Company, the main content of which was: the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000 discounted by BSH Huayang Company at Chuzhou BOC had been reported lost by an intermediate endorser on August 2, 2010; Chuzhou BOC discovered this on November 30, 2010, upon receiving a list of court-ordered stop-payments from the Anhui Provincial Branch of Bank of China Limited, and notified BSH Huayang Company on the same day that the draft had been treated as a return. On December 13, 2010, BSH Company returned the bank acceptance draft to the plaintiff Dayang Company. On December 22, 2010, Chuzhou BOC debited RMB 300,000 from the account of BSH Huayang Company.

On December 22, 2010, BSH Huayang Company sent a letter to the defendant BSH Company, the main content of which was: the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000 that BSH Huayang Company had received from BSH Company on July 21, 2010, had been the subject of an annulment judgment announced by the court on October 20, 2010, declaring the instrument invalid and confirming that Hongteng Company was entitled to claim payment of the RMB 300,000 under the instrument; for this reason, Chuzhou BOC, in accordance with the provisions of the discount agreement, debited RMB 300,000, an amount equal to the face amount of the bank acceptance draft, from the account of BSH Huayang Company on December 22, 2010. BSH Huayang Company demanded that BSH Company refund the RMB 300,000 that had not been paid under the draft.

On December 23, 2010, the defendant BSH Company issued a notice of draft return to the plaintiff Dayang Company, the main content of which was: in accordance with the sales contracts between the parties, Dayang Company had previously endorsed and delivered a bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 as payment of RMB 300,000 for goods; however, the third endorser of the instrument, Hongteng Company, applied to the court for public summons for exhortation, and after the court rendered an annulment judgment and announced it, the instrument was declared invalid and Hongteng Company was confirmed to be entitled to claim payment of the RMB 300,000 under the instrument; the subsequent holder of BSH Company under the instrument had claimed back the funds from BSH Company and returned the instrument; BSH Company decided to deduct RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment account as payment for goods under the 2010 sales contracts. A dispute thus arose between Dayang Company and BSH Company.

Separately found: BSH Huayang Company confirmed that the defendant BSH Company had refunded the RMB 300,000 payment for goods, and BSH Company had actually deducted RMB 300,000 from the plaintiff Dayang Company's prepayment account.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence: three home appliance sales contracts, a bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426, a receipt from the defendant BSH Company, a discount agreement, a discount voucher, an explanation of discount and draft return from Chuzhou BOC, a notice of draft return from BSH Huayang Company, an explanation of repayment after draft return from BSH Huayang Company, a notice of draft return from BSH Company, two notices from the Xinghualing Court, and the trial transcript. The court confirms these facts.

The issue in dispute at first instance was whether the defendant BSH Company's return of the bank acceptance draft to the plaintiff Dayang Company and deduction of RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment harmed Dayang Company's lawful rights and interests.

The Gulou District People's Court of Nanjing City held at first instance:

This case arose because Hongteng Company applied to the court for public summons for exhortation with respect to the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000. After the court rendered an annulment judgment, the defendant BSH Company deducted RMB 300,000 from the plaintiff Dayang Company's prepayment and returned the bank acceptance draft. Dayang Company filed this lawsuit, arguing that BSH Company should not have deducted the RMB 300,000 prepayment, and seeking an order that BSH Company continue to supply goods. The dispute between Dayang Company and BSH Company is a dispute over a sales contract. The 2010 Siemens refrigerator/washing machine sales contract, the 2010 Siemens water heater/kitchen appliance sales contract, and the 2010 Bosch refrigerator/washing machine/wine cooler sales contract entered into by Dayang Company and BSH Company are all lawful and valid and shall be protected by law.

In the course of performing the sales contracts, the defendant BSH Company's return of the annulled bank acceptance draft to the plaintiff Dayang Company and deduction of RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment did not harm Dayang Company's lawful rights and interests. The main reasons are as follows:

First, the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000 held by the plaintiff Dayang Company complied with the statutory requirements, had an uninterrupted chain of endorsements, and represented a clear instrument relationship. When Dayang Company made payment to the defendant BSH Company, it was entitled to endorse the bank acceptance draft to BSH Company. BSH Company was entitled to endorse the bank acceptance draft to BSH Huayang Company, with which it had a genuine transaction relationship. BSH Huayang Company was also entitled to apply for discount with Chuzhou BOC. Chuzhou BOC obtained the bank acceptance draft before the public summons for exhortation and should be considered the last lawful holder of the instrument.

Second, from the date of announcement of the court's annulment judgment, the instrument loses its validity, and the holder loses the rights under the instrument. The annulment judgment constitutes a reaffirmation of rights. It neither creates new rights under the instrument nor restores the substantive rights on the instrument. The content of the rights under the instrument confirmed by the annulment judgment shall be consistent with the rights under the instrument declared invalid, and it does not have any superiority over the rights recorded on the original instrument. It separates the original holder of the rights that were attached to the instrument from the instrument, such that the applicant for public summons for exhortation is entitled to request payment from the drawee on the basis of the annulment judgment. However, the loss of rights under the instrument does not mean the loss of the underlying civil rights. The holder is still entitled to assert civil rights based on the underlying contract. In this case, Chuzhou BOC did not declare its rights under the instrument during the period of public summons for exhortation, resulting in the court rendering an annulment judgment with respect to the bank acceptance draft. Chuzhou BOC lost its rights under the instrument, but it could still assert recourse against BSH Huayang Company for the discounted amount based on the underlying relationship, i.e., the discount contract.

Third, BSH Huayang Company also lost its rights under the instrument because the bank acceptance draft was annulled by the court's judgment, but it did not lose its underlying civil rights. It was entitled to assert that the payment by the defendant BSH Company was invalid based on the underlying legal relationship between them and demand that BSH Company re-perform its payment obligation. Similarly, BSH Huayang Company had already asserted its underlying civil rights against BSH Company. Although BSH Company could no longer assert rights under the bank acceptance draft, it remained entitled to exercise its civil rights based on the sales contract between it and the plaintiff Dayang Company and demand RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company. In this case, BSH Company deducted RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment, returned the bank acceptance draft, and issued a notice of draft return to Dayang Company. This constituted the exercise of the right of set-off by BSH Company in resolving issues in the performance of the sales contract with Dayang Company, which complies with the relevant provisions of the Contract Law of the PRC. Therefore, BSH Company's deduction of RMB 300,000 from Dayang Company's prepayment did not harm Dayang Company's lawful rights and interests.

In summary, the court held that the bank acceptance draft numbered GA0101930426 with a face amount of RMB 300,000 endorsed by the plaintiff Dayang Company to the defendant BSH Company was annulled and rendered invalid by the court's judgment. BSH Company's exercise of its civil rights based on the underlying relationship and return of the bank acceptance draft did not violate the law. Dayang Company's claim that BSH Company's deduction of RMB 300,000 from its prepayment account constituted infringement lacked factual and legal basis and was not adopted by the court. BSH Company's defense was well-founded and was adopted by the court. Therefore, Dayang Company's claims for an order that BSH Company not deduct the corresponding payment and that BSH Company continue to perform its obligation to supply goods could not be upheld and were not supported by the court. If Dayang Company indeed has an underlying civil transaction relationship, it may, while holding the bank acceptance draft, still assert its rights against the counterparty to the transaction and obtain relief under the law.

Accordingly, in accordance with Article 18 of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC, Article 16 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Disputes over Negotiable Instruments, Articles 60, 99, and 107 of the Contract Law of the PRC, and Article 128 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the Gulou District People's Court of Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, rendered the following judgment on March 15, 2011:

Reject all claims of Dayang Company.

After the judgment of first instance was announced, the parties did not appeal within the statutory time limit, and the judgment of first instance has become legally effective.
